items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And we played jobs all the way down to Burris and all over the country towns and all of that.

ctx.x: No, Benny Miller played banjo and guitar, and Lloyd Miller played drums. And you might have heard of Kero, Irving Kero, he played trumpet. He works for the public service now. And we played jobs all the way down to Burris and all over the country towns and all of that.
Was there a trombone playing in the band?
